focus: feel and animation: locomotion, responsiveness, camera, combat feel, feedback
method: Image fK = telemetry index K*every (walk, sprint_stop, punch_walker and punch_approach every 3; knockout every 6; shore every 4; shove and jump every 2; phone every 15). Planted-foot slip is defined as in r3: a foot counts as planted when (foot y - player y) < scenario floor (3rd percentile) + 0.03 m and |foot vy| < 0.25 m/s, and the value is that foot's horizontal world speed. Results, r4 vs r3 (mean / p90 / fraction > 0.3 m/s): walk 0.16/0.37/12% (r3 0.15/0.23/7%); sprint_stop 0.38/1.13/23% (0.13/0.44/15%); shore 0.33/1.19/26% (0.49/0.94/60%); punch_approach 0.28/0.70/13% (0.28/0.99/19%); punch_walker 0.17/0.41/14% (0.15/0.38/14%); knockout 0.08/0.09/4% (0.06/0.15/5%); jump 1.06/2.77 (few samples, dominated by the start). Max single-frame foot displacement: 0.41-0.42 m in punch_walker t70, punch_approach t70 and knockout t42. Caveats: (1) docs/play/STATUS.md has no 'After play-r3' section (it only has the r1 row), so I reconstructed the changes from the code against my r3 fix list. (2) src/modules/game/index.js (16:31:50) and dist/index.html (16:31:51) are both newer than the last capture (phone, 16:30:56), so the build that was captured is not exactly the source I read. (3) run_turns and side_run were not recaptured. I used the r3 numbers for them; they predate the fixes.

evidence.locomotion: Improved: (a) The jump gait is frozen in the air. Airborne feet move at body speed, 3.47-3.55 m/s against a body speed of 3.5, so they are still relative to the body (jump t26-t36; r3 had 4-7 m/s of leg cycling). (b) The walk stop is shorter: 17 frames and about 0.35 m (walk t65-t82; r3 took 35 frames and 0.41 m). (c) The sprint into the quay no longer pops from 2.05 to 0: it brakes smoothly to 0 at t82 (sprint_stop t66-t82, 1.98 -> 1.69 -> 1.42 -> ... -> 0.19 -> 0). Not fixed: (d) Every start from standing still drags the feet. A foot at floor height slides 3.0-3.7 m/s at t2-t4 in sprint_stop, shove, punch_approach, jump and phone (sprint_stop t3 lf 3.58 at h-0.00; shove t3 lf 3.73 at h-0.01). The walk start drags lf 1.5-3.4 m/s at 2-6 cm for t2-t9. This is no better than r3's 2.5-4.1 m/s. The passing-pose reset (character.js line 119) does not help, because the drag is the cross-fade from the idle pose to the walk pose (wIdle falls over 4-6 frames) and not the walk phase. (e) The walk_stop entry ignores the gait phase. In this capture the stick was released one frame earlier in the cycle (t65 instead of t66), and both feet slid on the floor at 2.8-4.0 m/s for 4 frames (walk t65-t68: lf 3.53/3.40/3.07/2.91 at h-0.01..0.00, rf 2.80/3.97 at h-0.02/+0.01). In r3 the planted foot happened to match (0.03-0.11 m/s). punch_approach t48-t50 shows the same thing: both feet 3.7-4.9 m/s at h-0.03..+0.02. The walk_stop still holds 0.82 m/s for 8 frames (t65-t72) before it tapers. (f) Landing: at touchdown (jump t38) the feet are +0.19/+0.41 m above the stance floor (r3 +0.25/+0.59), and they stay above it for 4 more frames (t39-t42: lf +0.13..+0.17, rf +0.36..+0.49). The landing crouch (character.js line 252, tuck += sin(landT*pi)*0.6) folds the knees without dropping the pelvis, so the feet hover for about 0.15 s after the body has landed. (g) The final settle at the quay slides both feet 2.5-3.95 m/s for 2 frames (shore t93-t94), because the run cycle decelerates to 0 with the stick held and no stop clip plays. Steady walk is still good (stance 0.02-0.12 m/s, walk t60-t64).
evidence.responsiveness: The approach is now a real movement input. It ramps 0 -> 3.98 m/s at 13 m/s^2 (punch_walker t16-t25), sp equals real on every approach frame (r3: sp 3.50, real 3.22), and maxAccel is 13. The first impact against the walker lands at t42, 27 frames (0.9 s) after the press at t15. r3 took 1.5 s; my target was 22 frames, so this misses by 0.15 s. 4 presses gave 3 swings. Press 3 (t51) was dropped: the 0.3 s C.next buffer runs out at t62, the same frame the cross reaches atk.t 0.62 (pT 0.59 at t61, 0.65 at t62), because the cross lasts 0.53 s and the hit-stop (t56-t59) adds to it. In knockout, all 4 presses produced swings, with press-to-impact 5-8 frames. With sprint held toward the water, the edge probe (reach = 0.4 + v^2/11 = 3.9 m) starts braking 3.9 m out. Speed falls from 6.2 to 2.0 over 0.73 s while the stick is still pushed (sprint_stop t43-t65). That is safe, but it takes the sprint away early. Turn response was not recaptured (r3: 90% in 0.47 s).
evidence.camera: The fight framing is tighter, as asked. dist lerps to max(3.4, 0.85 x 4.4) = 3.74 m, and the player fills about 40-47% of the frame height in fights (punch_walker f014-f017, knockout f003-f008; r3 about 25%). That meets the >= 33% acceptance. The 3/4 swing reads well in knockout (f002-f008 show both fighters side-on). Against the walker, the first impact is hidden: at f013-f014 (t39-t42) the victim is directly behind the player. The camera only reaches the 3/4 at f016-f017, because the swing is capped at 1.5 rad/s while the bearing to a moving target keeps changing. The camera keeps sweeping about 0.6 rad across the fight (f014 -> f020 buildings slide across the frame). Benches still cross the near field (jump f020-f023, sprint_stop f014, phone f004) but never cover the player; the prop fade was not implemented. Sprint FOV kick and shake stay restrained. Desktop framing is unchanged at about 0.44 of the width.
evidence.combat: Better: (a) Spacing is fixed. The ped distance at each hit is 1.05/1.06/1.07 m (knockout t11/t31/t49) and 1.02/1.04/1.07 (punch_approach), against 0.69 in r3. That meets the 0.8-1.2 acceptance. (b) The lunge is a 4-frame step at <= 4.0 m/s (knockout t24-t27: 3.31-3.42; t42-t45: 3.41-4.00) with a visible long stride (knockout f004, f007), not the r3 2-frame 7 m/s skate. (c) The strikes read: the fist reaches the victim's chin, with torso twist (knockout f005 cross, f008 hook), and the victim's arm comes up on the flinch. (d) Hits are 3/3 in every scenario, KO on the 3rd, hit-stop 3-4 frames, KO slow-mo t54-t64. Worse or still open: (1) Every lunge from a standstill pops the lead foot 0.41-0.42 m in one frame (12.4-12.6 m/s: knockout t24 and t42, punch_approach t70 and t88, punch_walker t70). animSpeed jumps from 0 to 1.21 in one frame (animWant 2.6 x 14*dt), so wIdle goes 1 -> 0 at once, and the wasIdle phase reset teleports the walk pose in on the same frame. (2) The lunge ends dead (4.00 -> 0 in one frame, knockout t45-t46), but the legs keep cycling for 3-4 frames on a body that isn't moving (knockout t9 lf 4.99/rf 5.64 at floor height with real 0; t46-t48 rf 3.0-5.6). (3) The lunge adds to the approach speed instead of replacing it. Real speed is 6.02/5.51/5.02 m/s at the strike start (punch_walker t35-t37), which fails the <= 4.1 acceptance, because the approach arrives at 3.27 m/s (target floor = q.speed + 1.6) and lungeV is added on top. (4) A dropped press (see responsiveness). (5) The walker victim mostly keeps walking between hits (punch_walker f020-f025). Code exists for her to answer back, but no counter-punch shows in this capture. The post-KO swing is now an air swing with no lunge (knockout t65), which is acceptable.
evidence.world_boundaries: Fixed: the quay twitch is gone. In shore the player brakes from 3.5 to 0 at t94 and never touches the lip (real equals sp on every frame), and holds still with the stick pushed (t95-t120 sp 0, feet 0.01 m/s). It stands neatly at the edge (shore f023-f026, sprint_stop f024-f028). The blocked-stop pop is gone. Left: (a) Edge braking is a sawtooth. The 0.15 m probe steps push speed back up by +0.23 m/s three times per approach (shore t77->t78 3.23->3.47, t83->t84, t86->t87; sprint_stop t53->t54, t59->t60, t64->t65). (b) The downed body is no longer a wall, but it is now a ghost. With stumbleT active, the lateral slide is skipped and the player runs straight through the sprawled ped's centre (shove d 0.71 -> 0.05 at t36, f018 shows the legs inside the body). The acceptance passes literally (real >= 0.8 x sp, 6 m past by t60), but it looks wrong.
evidence.npc_behaviour: The code now gives bystanders a mix of flee, cower and film, a witness who phones it in (the toast in punch_approach f024, then a star from f027), and shove victims who sometimes come back to fight. In the captures: the stagger knocks the victim back 0.2-0.4 m (punch_walker d 1.04 -> 1.26 over t42-t49, 1.07 -> 1.46 over t56-t69). The KO fall buckles, then sprawls (punch_walker f030-f036). The sprint knock-down flings the ped forward (shove f017-f021). The idle ped still drifts 0.12 m toward the player before the first punch (knockout d 1.22 -> 1.10, t1-t6). The walker keeps her walk cadence through hits, and no fight-back is visible. A KO'd body from the previous scenario lies next to the punch_approach target (f000-f015). That is the harness not clearing it, not a game bug.
evidence.hud_ux: Unchanged and solid. Lock chevron and health bar over the target (punch_walker f003-f017). Wanted stars and the witness toast are legible (punch_approach f024-f039). Phone thumb cluster is sized well, and ENTER is dimmed (phone f003). The health, stamina and cash readouts auto-hide when idle (knockout f002+, jump f015+), which is fine and GTA-like.
evidence.feedback: Code check of r3 fix 10: haptics are now present (navigator.vibrate 16/30/45 ms on hits, 8 ms on a block, 22 ms when punched, 25 ms on a shove knock-down). The shove knock-down has a 0.3 shake. Blocks get their own feedback: a 0.03 s hit-stop and a concrete tick. Hit-stop and KO slow-mo are visible in telemetry (pT frozen t43-t45 and t57-t59; slow-mo t54-t64 in knockout). Still missing: footsteps are suppressed while a start or stop clip plays (character.js line 157, `!this.trans`), so the braking plant step is silent. Landing is a single generic thud, and the foot-hover above means it fires about 0.15 s before the feet visually land.
evidence.fun_loop: This is judged from code plus what the capture shows. A punch-up now pays out a wallet, triggers a witness call with a 4 s grace window and 1 star, and bystanders react in varied ways. That gives assault an emergent consequence. Missions, police chases and jobs are not exercised in these scenarios. Brawling a walker is now workable (first hit 0.9 s), but the foot pops and the dropped press still make it feel slightly unreliable.
evidence.stability: No page errors in metrics.log. Glitches seen: 5 one-frame foot teleports of 0.41-0.42 m (all standing lunges). After a teleport, animSpeed carries over: P.teleport doesn't reset P.animSpeed, so in knockout t1-t5 the feet slide 1.8-3.6 m/s with sp 0, continuing the previous scenario's 3.5 m/s run. Speed sawtooth at the quay. A body persists across scenarios (harness). The source and dist changed after the capture (see method).

fixes.fix: Kill the lunge foot pop and the post-lunge moonwalk. (1) In Character.update, rate-limit the idle weight so it can never fall faster than 1 per 0.12 s: this.wIdleS = Math.max(1 - smoothstep(v, 0.05, 0.9), (this.wIdleS ?? 1) - dt / 0.12); use this.wIdleS for wIdle, and apply the line-119 phase reset only when this.wIdleS > 0.95 (a genuine standing start), not on any frame where v crosses 0.05. (2) In player.js line 204, drive the lunge legs from the body's real horizontal speed: animWant = Math.max(P.speed, turnStep, lungeV ? Math.hypot(vx, vz) : 0), and use a 22/s lerp when animWant < P.animSpeed and the lunge has just ended (C.lungeT <= 0 && prevLunge), so the walk cycle stops within about 3 frames of the body stopping. (3) Ease the end of the lunge instead of 4 -> 0 in one frame: lungeV = Math.min(lungeV, (d - 0.95) / 0.06) so it decelerates over the last 2 frames. Acceptance: no foot displacement > 0.12 m in any single frame in knockout, punch_approach and punch_walker (now 0.41-0.42 m at knockout t24/t42, punch_approach t70/t88, punch_walker t70); knockout t8-t10 and t45-t49 have no foot within floor + 0.03 m moving > 1.0 m/s while real < 0.2.

The lunge replaces carried speed instead of adding to it, and the approach brakes into range. (1) In the lunge block (lines 124-129), project out the existing velocity first: const ux = (t.x-P.x)/d, uz = (t.z-P.z)/d, along = vx*ux + vz*uz; lungeV = Math.max(0, lungeV - Math.max(0, along)), so the total closing speed is max(carried, lunge) <= 4.0. On the first lunge frame also set P.speed = Math.min(P.speed, 1.0). (2) Approach (line 68): target = Math.min(PLAYER.run + 0.6, Math.max(qs + 0.8, Math.sqrt(2 * 9 * Math.max(0, d - 1.1)))), so the player arrives at about 2.5 m/s, not 3.3. Hand over to the strike at d < 2.3 when qs > 0.5 (d < 1.9 otherwise), because the lunge (up to 0.3 s x 4 m/s) covers it. (3) Raise the approach timeout to 1.0 s. Acceptance: punch_walker real speed <= 4.2 m/s on every frame (now 6.02 at t35); first hits increment within 22 frames of the press at t15 (now 27); punch_walker and punch_approach maxAccel <= 15 m/s^2 excluding hit-stop frames.

Never drop a melee press. Line 218: if ch.atk is active (or C.next is already pending), queue it as a chain, `C.chain = Math.min(2, (C.chain || 0) + 1)`, instead of starting the 0.3 s C.next timer. Line 219 then fires it when atk.t > 0.55, as for approach-queued presses. Keep C.next = 0.3 only for presses made while idle. Make the C.next decrement use the hit-stop-scaled dt (it already does) and don't let it expire while ch.atk.t < 0.62. Acceptance: punch_walker gives 4 swings from 4 presses (pT resets to 0 four times; now 3, with press 3 at t51 lost at t62); knockout still gives exactly 4 swings.

Use the walk_start and run_start clips that avatars.js already loads (TRANS_CLIPS line 28) for standing starts, exactly like the stops. In updateOnFoot, when prev < 0.1, want > 0.3, trOK and |dy| < 0.8, call ch.playTrans(target > PLAYER.walk + 0.3 ? 'run_start' : 'walk_start', { rate: 1.0-1.3 }) and drive P.speed from the low-passed transDelta/dt (the same code as lines 102-105, but bounded above by target instead of below by prev). Exit to the loco blend when transT > 0.7 or P.speed >= 0.9 * target, with ch.stopTrans(0.2). Cancel on |dy| > 1.2 (pivot instead). Also reset P.animSpeed = 0, P.yawRate = 0 and ch.stopTrans(0) in P.teleport, which stops the carried-over 1.8-3.6 m/s foot slide at knockout t1-t5. Acceptance: walk, sprint_stop, shove, jump, phone and punch_approach frames t1-t8 have no foot within floor + 0.03 m moving > 0.6 m/s (now 3.0-3.7 at t2-t4); time to 3.5 m/s from standing <= 0.55 s.

Phase-match the stop entry and remove the walk_stop plateau. At line 107, read the gait phase (expose ch.gaitPhase = phase from character.js line 155). Enter walk_stop only when the planted foot matches the clip's first plant, i.e. phase within 0.0-0.15 for the left-plant start (find the mirrored window for the right foot, or start the clip at the half-cycle offset start + 0.5 x stepDur). Otherwise keep braking at 8.5 m/s^2 for up to 0.2 s until the window arrives. Drop the walk_stop start time to 0.28 so the 0.82 m/s plateau (8 frames, walk t65-t72) is skipped. While a start or stop clip plays, fire onFootstep when a foot's height drops within 0.012 m of its floor after being 0.03 m above it (latched per foot), instead of `!this.trans` at character.js line 157. Acceptance: walk t64-t75 and punch_approach t47-t51 have no foot within floor + 0.03 m moving > 0.6 m/s (now 2.8-4.9 m/s); the walk stop reaches 0 in <= 15 frames; at least one step event fires during each stop clip.

Land on the feet. In upperBody (line 252), split the tuck: airborne tuck = airW * clamp(this.airH / 0.35, 0, 1), with player.js passing ch.airH = P.y - g.y and descending (so the legs extend in the last 0.1 s). The landing absorb must lower the pelvis rather than lift the feet: this.body.position.y -= 0.10 * Math.sin(landT * Math.PI), and the thigh/calf bend = 0.35/-0.6 * sin(landT * pi) applied with the root lowered, so the feet stay on the floor. Acceptance: jump t38 (the first onG frame) min(lf, rf) height <= floor + 0.05 m (now +0.19/+0.41); t39-t43 both feet <= floor + 0.08 m at least once per frame (now +0.13..+0.49).

Monotonic edge brake, a planted final stop, and no walking through bodies. (1) Lines 86-91: after the coarse 0.15 m probe hits, bisect between dd - 0.15 and dd three times to get the edge distance to about 2 cm, then clamp tgt <= (P.edgeTgt ?? tgt) + 0.4 * dt and store P.edgeTgt (reset when edgeBrake is false). That removes the +0.23 m/s bumps (shore t78/t84/t87, sprint_stop t54/t60/t65). (2) When edgeBrake is true and P.speed < 1.3 with the stick still held, start walk_stop once (as at line 110) so the settle plants instead of sliding (shore t93-t94, 2.5-3.95 m/s). (3) Downed bodies (lines 159-166): keep the lateral side-step active during stumbleT at half strength (pen * 0.4) and never allow d < 0.35. Alternatively, raise the swing foot over the body by setting ch.airW = Math.max(ch.airW, 0.35) for 0.2 s when 0.2 < d < 0.6, so the legs don't pass through it. Acceptance: shore sp is non-increasing from t76 to t94; shore t92-t96 planted slip < 0.3 m/s; shove minimum player-body distance >= 0.35 m (now 0.05 at t36) with real >= 0.8 x sp.

Get the fight camera to the 3/4 before the first impact, and clear the near field. In updateCamera (lines 287-290), when P.combat.approach or P.combat.lungeT > 0, aim the swing at the target's predicted position (fp + q velocity x 0.3 s). Raise the swing rate clamp from 1.5 to 3.0 rad/s while P.fightK < 1, and drop back to 1.5 after. Lower the look target by 0.15 x fightK (chest height), as asked in r3. For props: cast col.segment from the camera to the player's hip and knee heights. Fade any bench or prop mesh within 1.6 m of the lens to opacity 0.3 (cache the material clones per mesh). Acceptance: punch_walker f013-f014 (the t42 impact) shows the victim's head and torso unoccluded by the player; jump f020-f023 and sprint_stop f014 show no bench between the lens and the player's bounding box at full opacity.

regressions: Standing lunges now pop the lead foot 0.41-0.42 m in a single frame (12.4-12.6 m/s) at knockout t24 and t42, punch_approach t70 and t88, and punch_walker t70. The cause is the new wasIdle phase reset (character.js line 119) together with animSpeed jumping 0 -> 1.21 in one frame from the lunge's animWant of 2.6. That drives wIdle 1 -> 0 in one frame. r3's worst knockout foot speed was 1.95 m/s.
After a lunge the legs keep cycling on a stationary body (knockout t9 both feet about 5 m/s at floor height with real 0; t46-t48), because the lunge drives animSpeed and then the body stops dead.
The approach and the lunge now stack, so the player runs into the strike at 6.02 m/s (punch_walker t35).
Downed bodies went from being walls to being walked through (shove d 0.05 at t36, f018).
Edge braking became a sawtooth (+0.23 m/s bumps three times per approach) from the 0.15 m probe steps.
improvements: Approach is a real movement input: 13 m/s^2, sp equals real, first hit on a walker 0.9 s (r3 1.5 s).
Hit spacing is 1.02-1.07 m (r3 0.56-0.69 point blank); the lunge is a 4-frame stride at <= 4 m/s.
Punches visibly reach the victim's chin with torso twist; fight camera puts the player at about 40% of frame height.
No blocked-stop pops or quay twitch: shore and sprint_stop brake smoothly and stop at the lip.
Jump legs hold the take-off stride in the air.
Walk stop roughly halved (17 frames, 0.35 m).
Haptics, block feedback, shove shake; bystanders flee/cower/film and a witness phones it in.
verdict: Real progress: this critic goes from 6.28 to 6.57, and no dimension is below 6. But it is not a pass. Combat now connects at the right range, and the quay and blocked-stop glitches are fixed. The feel ceiling is now the animation layer. Every standing lunge pops a foot 0.42 m in one frame, every standing start still drags the feet, the stop entry slides when the gait phase is wrong, the landing hovers, and the approach stacks with the lunge into a 6 m/s strike. Fixes 1-4 are what's needed to move locomotion and combat past 7.
